LUXEMBOURG, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Globant (NYSE: GLOB) today announced results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

"As an AI-native company, we are seeing our momentum accelerate, with AI Pods reaching an annualized run rate of $106.6 million in the third quarter, more than doubling quarter-over-quarter and positioning us to exceed $130 million by year end. This quarter, we completed the rollout of Glob.AI, our AI-native services platform comprising our AI Pods and Glob.AI OS, an operating system that provides governance and traceability. We are seeing growing enterprise adoption as clients shift from hourly billing toward outcome- and consumption-based delivery. Supported by an expanding partner ecosystem and two decades of engineering playbooks, we believe we are well positioned to help our clients accelerate their AI transformation", explained Martín Migoya, Globant's CEO and co-founder.

"In Q3 2026, Globant delivered $611.1 million in revenue, in line with the midpoint of our guidance, and expanded adjusted operating margin sequentially to 14.1%. Core client expansion remained strong, highlighted by a 5.7% year-over-year increase in top 50 accounts and record revenue per head of $99.8 thousand. Supported by streamlined operations, debt maturities extended to 2031, and $25.0 million in Q3 share repurchases, we believe our strong balance sheet and robust cash conversion will enable us to navigate regional headwinds while advancing our business model transformation. Given current market valuations, we have upsized our share repurchase program from $125 million to $250 million through December 2027," stated Juan Urthiague, Globant's CFO.

Please see highlights below. Note that reconciliations between IFRS and Non-IFRS financial measures are disclosed at the end of this press release.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Revenues were $611.1 million, representing a 1.0% year-over-year decline
  • IFRS Gross Profit Margin was 34.1% compared to 34.8% in the third quarter of 2025.
  • Non-IFRS Adjusted Gross Profit Margin was 36.8% compared to 38.1% in the third quarter of 2025.
  • IFRS Profit from Operations Margin was 4.4% compared to 9.1% in the third quarter of 2025.
  • Non-IFRS Adjusted Profit from Operations Margin was 14.1% compared to 15.5% in the third quarter of 2025.
  • IFRS Diluted EPS was $0.32 compared to $0.73 in the third quarter of 2025.
  • Non-IFRS Adjusted Diluted EPS was $1.48 compared to $1.53 in the third quarter of 2025.

Other Financial Highlights as of and for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

  • Cash and cash equivalents and Short-term investments were $153.6 million as of September 30, 2026.
  • The Company invested $25.0 million during the third quarter under its share repurchase program.
  • Globant completed the third quarter of 2026 with 26,164 Globers, 24,486 of whom were technology, design and innovation professionals.
  • The geographic revenue breakdown for the third quarter of 2026 was as follows: 54.2% from North America (top country: US), 21.8% from Latin America (top country: Argentina), 19.5% from Europe (top country: Spain) and 4.5% from New Markets1 (top country: Saudi Arabia).
  • Globant's top customer, top five customers and top ten customers for the third quarter of 2026 represented 9.8%, 21.7% and 31.2% of revenues, respectively.
  • During the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, Globant served a total of 882 customers (with revenues over $100,000 in the last twelve months), with 321 accounts generating more than $1 million of annual revenues, compared to 339 for the same period one year ago.
  • In terms of currencies, 65.5% of Globant's revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were denominated in US dollars.

2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Outlook

Based on current market conditions, Globant is providing the following estimates for the fourth quarter and the full year of 2026:

  • Fourth quarter 2026 Revenues are estimated to be in the range of $596 million to $604 million, representing a 2.7% to 1.4% year-over-year decline. This expected decline includes a neutral FX outlook.
  • Fourth quarter 2026 Non-IFRS Adjusted Profit from Operations Margin is estimated to be in the range of 13.5% to 14.5%.
  • Fourth quarter 2026 Non-IFRS Adjusted Diluted EPS is estimated to be in the range of $1.43 to $1.53 (assuming an average of 43.3 million diluted shares outstanding during the fourth quarter).
  • Fiscal year 2026 Revenues are estimated to be in the range of $2,429 million to $2,437 million, implying a 1.1% to 0.7% year-over-year decline. This expected decline includes a positive FX impact of 70 basis points.
  • Fiscal year 2026 Non-IFRS Adjusted Profit from Operations Margin is estimated to be in the range of 13.5% to 14.5%.
  • Fiscal year 2026 Non-IFRS Adjusted Diluted EPS is estimated to be in the range of $5.77 to $5.87 (assuming an average of 43.5 million diluted shares outstanding during 2026).

Shareholder Letter, Conference Call and Webcast 
A shareholder letter will be available in the Investor Relations section of Globant's website.

Martin Migoya, Chief Executive Officer and co-founder, Diego Tártara, Chief Technology Officer, Juan Urthiague, Chief Financial Officer, and Fernando Matzkin, Chief Operating Officer, will discuss the results in a video conference call and a live Q&A session beginning today at 4:30 pm ET.

Video conference call access information is:
https://more.globant.com/F3Q26EarningsCall  
Webcast http://investors.globant.com/ 

About Globant (NYSE:GLOB)

Globant (NYSE: GLOB) is a global AI-native services company that helps organizations reinvent themselves and drive measurable business results by combining technology, creativity and innovation with AI at its core. Through Glob.AI, its AI-native technology services model and its signature AI Pods, agentic service units supervised by experts, Globant delivers enterprise-grade technology services tied directly to core business metrics.

Present across 30+ countries, Globant operates a network of industry-specific AI Studios and partners with global brands including FIFA, Google, Riot Games, the LA Clippers and Santander. Recognized by IDC MarketScape as a Worldwide Leader in Experience Design Services (2025) and a Leader in AI Services (2023), Globant's work is featured as business case studies at Harvard, MIT and Stanford. The company collaborates with leading technology platforms including Anthropic, NVIDIA, AWS and Unity.

For more information, please visit www.globant.com

Non-IFRS Financial Measures

While the financial figures included in this press release have been computed in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board ("IASB"), this announcement does not contain sufficient information to constitute an interim financial report as defined in International Accounting Standards 34, "Interim Financial Reporting" or a financial statement as defined by International Accounting Standards 1 "Presentation of Financial Statements". The financial information in this press release has not been audited. 

Globant provides non-IFRS financial measures in addition to reported IFRS results prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards. Management believes these measures help illustrate underlying trends in the company's business and uses the non-IFRS financial measures to establish budgets and operational goals, communicated internally and externally, for managing the company's business and evaluating its performance. The company anticipates that it will continue to report both IFRS and certain non-IFRS financial measures in its financial results, including non-IFRS measures that exclude share-based compensation expense, depreciation and amortization, acquisition-related charges, business optimization costs, and the related effect on income taxes of the pre-tax adjustments. Because the company's non-IFRS financial measures are not calculated according to IFRS, these measures are not comparable to IFRS and may not necessarily be comparable to similarly described non-IFRS measures reported by other companies within the company's industry. Consequently, Globant's non-IFRS financial measures should not be evaluated in isolation or supplant comparable IFRS measures, but, rather, should be considered together with its condensed interim consolidated statements of financial position as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025 and its condensed interim consolidated statements of comprehensive income for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, prepared in accordance with International Accounting Standard ("IAS") 34, "Interim Financial Reporting".

Globant is not providing a quantitative reconciliation of forward-looking Non-IFRS Adjusted Profit from Operations Margin or Non-IFRS Adjusted Diluted EPS to the most directly comparable IFRS measure because it is unable to predict with reasonable certainty the ultimate outcome of certain significant items without unreasonable effort. These items include, but are not limited to, share-based compensation expense, acquisition-related charges, business optimization costs, and the tax effect of non-IFRS adjustments. These items are uncertain, depend on various factors, and could have a material impact on IFRS reported results for the guidance period.

In some cases, you can identify forward-looking statements by terminology such as "believe," "may," "will," "estimate," "continue," "anticipate," "intend," "should," "plan," "expect," "predict," "potential," or the negative of these terms or other similar expressions. These statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding our future financial and operating performance, including our outlook and guidance, and our strategies, priorities and business plans. Our expectations and beliefs regarding these matters may not materialize, and actual results in future periods are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected. Factors that could impact our actual results include: our ability to maintain current resource utilization rates and productivity levels; our ability to manage attrition and attract and retain highly-skilled IT professionals; our ability to accurately price our client contracts; our ability to achieve our anticipated growth; our ability to effectively manage our rapid growth; our ability to retain our senior management team and other key employees; our ability to continue to innovate and remain at the forefront of emerging technologies and related market trends; our ability to retain our business relationships and client contracts; our ability to manage the impact of global adverse economic conditions; our ability to manage uncertainty concerning the instability in the current economic, political and social environment in Latin America; and other factors discussed under the heading "Risk Factors" in our most recent Form 20-F filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and any other risk factors we include in subsequent reports on Form 6-K.

Additionally, while we have concluded, for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026 presented in the condensed interim consolidated statements of comprehensive income included in this press release, that our goodwill and intangible assets are not impaired, changes in economic or operating conditions impacting our estimates and assumptions could, as noted in our most recent Form 20-F, result in the impairment of our goodwill and intangible assets in future periods.

Because of these uncertainties, you should not make any investment decisions based on our estimates and forward-looking statements. ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The Board of Directors of Carter’s, Inc. (NYSE:CRI) today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share, payable on December 18, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 3, 2026.

Future declarations of quarterly dividends and the establishment of future record and payment dates will be at the discretion of the Company’s Board of Directors based on a number of factors, including business conditions, the Company’s future financial performance, investment priorities, and other considerations.

About Carter’s, Inc.

Carter’s, Inc. is North America’s largest and most-enduring apparel company exclusively for babies and young children. The Company’s core brands are Carter’s and OshKosh B’gosh, iconic and among the sector’s most trusted names. These brands are sold through more than 1,000 Company-operated stores in the United States, Canada, and Mexico and online at www.carters.com, www.oshkosh.com, www.cartersoshkosh.ca, and www.carters.com.mx. Carter’s also is the largest supplier of baby and young children’s apparel to North America’s biggest retailers. The Company’s Child of Mine brand is available exclusively at Walmart, its Just One You brand is available at Target, and its Simple Joys brand is available on Amazon.com. The Company’s emerging brands include Little Planet, crafted with organic fabrics and sustainable materials, Otter Avenue, a toddler-focused apparel brand, and Skip Hop, baby essentials from tubs to toys. Carter’s is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Additional information may be found at www.carters.com.

FAYETTE, Ind., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Wabash (NYSE: WNC) today announced that its board of directors declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.08 per share of the company’s common stock, payable on January 28, 2027, to stockholders of record on January 7, 2027.

About

Wabash (NYSE: WNC) is the visionary leader of connected solutions for the transportation, logistics and distribution industries that is Changing How the World Reaches You®. Headquartered in Lafayette, Indiana, the company enables customers to thrive by providing insight into tomorrow and delivering pragmatic solutions today to move everything from first to final mile. Wabash designs, manufactures, and services a diverse range of products, including: dry freight and refrigerated trailers, flatbed trailers, tank trailers, dry and refrigerated truck bodies, structural composite panels and products, trailer aerodynamic solutions, and specialty food grade processing equipment. Learn more at www.onewabash.com.

TAMPA, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 19, 2026 / DataMeds AI, Inc. ("DataMeds SI," "DataMeds AI," "DataMEDS" or the "Company") (NASDAQ:MEDS), a healthcare technology company that integrates its physical pharmaceutical, laboratory and telemedicine infrastructures with its EinsteinRx™ Healthcare AI technology-powered digital platform, today announced that it has agreed to acquire certain assets from the estate of Todos Medical Ltd., including its Cancer Artificial Intelligence ("Cancer AI") Total Biochemical Infrared Analysis ("TBIA") blood tests for breast cancer (TM-B1 and TM-B2) and colorectal cancer (TM-C1), originally developed at Ben Gurion University (BGU) in Israel.

The TBIA Cancer AI blood testing platform leverages Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy biochemical analysis of blood plasma and peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) components to distinguish between healthy subjects and patients with cancer.

Because FTIR digitizes the biochemical information contained in a blood sample, the test is designed to multiplex algorithms for multiple different cancer tests and disease states using the same blood draw, allowing for the identification of various types of cancer in blood without the need for antibodies or other biological inputs, helping to improve test scalability and reducing per-test cost of goods sold (COGS). The technology was also previously used to identify and distinguish between viral and bacterial infections. The TBIA Cancer AI blood testing platform is covered by issued U.S. and European patents, providing market exclusivity into at least 2034.with expected terms extending into at least 2034.

"The TBIA Cancer AI blood testing platform is a technology that was ahead of its time and now has the opportunity to truly flourish in the AI era," said Gerald Commissiong, Interim Co-CEO of DataMEDS. "To be able to use a single vial of blood, perform a single data capture experiment in the lab and produce results that can help detect multiple types of cancer from that one blood test is truly transformative. This has the potential to make cancer detection not only less expensive to deploy on a per-cancer-diagnosis basis than existing liquid biopsy and other cancer screening tests, but also more clinically useful because this technology digitizes the immune system and as such may be able to identify and distinguish the body's response to cancer, even at the earliest carcinoma in situ stage. Earlier detection could open the possibility of its use in routine annual blood testing paradigms that would allow patients to be recommended for confirmatory imaging and biopsy testing much earlier in the disease course where cancers are typically significantly more likely to respond to treatment. We look forward to implementing this technology at our Helomics Cancer AI laboratory in Pittsburgh, Penn., where we will work with our emerging oncologist network to source blood samples, under IRB-approved protocols and with patient consent, from patients whose treating physicians are sending in tumor biopsies for the ChemoFx® Assay evaluation, that has been granted two unique CPT codes and has begun to receive coverage decisions, helping us to generate revenue while also generating the necessary data to validate the TBIA Cancer AI blood test to support eventual commercial launch as a Laboratory Developed Test and to advance it through the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) regulatory process thereafter."

Other assets the Company agreed to acquire include Todos' license to the LymPro™ Alzheimer's diagnostic blood test and 100% of the shares of Todos' wholly-owned subsidiary Todos Medical Singapore PTE Ltd., which previously owned equity in Pathnova Labs PTE Ltd. that was recently exchanged for shares Archerfish Precision Diagnostics Pte Ltd. following Pathnova's merger with Angsana Molecular & Diagnostics Laboratory.

The global cancer diagnostics market size was valued at USD 189.19 Billion in 2024 and is projected to grow to USD 386.19 Billion by 2035, according to Market Research Future.

The agreement to acquire these assets from the estate of Todos Medical is subject to Court Approval. The TBIA tests have not been cleared or approved by the FDA and are not currently commercially available in the United States.

CLEVELAND--(BUSINESS WIRE)--TFS Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: TFSL) (the “Company”), the holding company for Third Federal Savings and Loan Association of Cleveland (the “Association”), today announced that the Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.3175 per share, payable on December 16, 2026, to stockholders of record on December 2, 2026.

Chairman and CEO Marc A. Stefanski

Third Federal Savings and Loan Association of Cleveland, MHC (the “MHC”), the mutual holding company of the Company and owner of 227,119,132 shares, or 81% of the Company’s common stock outstanding, has waived its right to receive the dividend on its shares.

On July 7, 2026, the MHC received the approval of its members (depositors and certain loan customers of the Association) with respect to the waiver of dividends, and subsequently received the non-objection of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, to waive receipt of dividends on the Company’s common stock the MHC owns up to an aggregate amount of $1.27 per share during the twelve months subsequent to the members' approval (ie., through July 7, 2027). The MHC previously waived the receipt of dividends paid by the Company in an aggregate amount of $0.3175 per share during the quarter ending September 30, 2026.

Third Federal is a leading provider of savings and mortgage products, and operates under the values of love, trust, respect, a commitment to excellence and fun. Founded in Cleveland in 1938 as a mutual association by Ben and Gerome Stefanski, Third Federal’s mission is to help people achieve the dream of home ownership and financial security while creating value for our customers, communities, associates and shareholders. It became part of a public company in 2007 and celebrated its 85th anniversary in May 2023. Third Federal, which lends in 28 states and the District of Columbia, is dedicated to serving consumers with competitive rates and outstanding service. Third Federal, an equal housing lender, has 21 full service branches in Northeast Ohio, two lending offices in Central and Southern Ohio, and 14 full service branches throughout Florida. As of September 30, 2026 the Company’s assets totaled $18.19 billion.

New direct integration connects Rapid Response's monitoring platform to Resideo's next-gen software experience, giving professional Dealers a faster, simpler way to set up, manage, and test their monitored accounts

SYRACUSE, N.Y., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rapid Response Monitoring, a leading third-party alarm monitoring provider, and Resideo Technologies (NYSE: REZI), a leading global provider of solutions for home comfort, security and safety, today announced that Rapid Response is the first Monitoring Center to integrate with Resideo One, part of Resideo's next-generation software and services platform for security professionals. The announcement coincides with Resideo's annual CONNECT Customer event, taking place Nov. 19–22 in Marco Island, Fla.

Rapid Response's new direct integration with Resideo One, a first for Monitoring Centers, simplifies account management.

Rapid Response pursued the integration with one goal in mind: taking time-consuming tasks off Dealers' plates so they can spend more time growing their businesses.

What the integration does
Resideo One offers a single dashboard where Dealers manage customer accounts, systems, branding, and insights, and it also integrates seamlessly with the Resideo Technician app and the Resideo Connect end-user app.

Rapid Response's monitoring platform, Triangulum AI®, connects directly to Resideo One through proprietary APIs, with no third party in between. Alarm signals from Resideo's First Alert® ProSeries are delivered to Rapid Response through an API instead of traditional alarm receivers, with no need for a 7810PC receiver, providing faster and more accurate install, activation and management. Resideo's platform runs on three geographically separate, redundant paths, and Rapid Response backs it with active-active fully redundant data centers on both coasts, so the connection is built for complete reliability.

Dealer Benefits
For Dealers who monitor with Rapid Response and use Resideo's First Alert® professional security products, the integration delivers:

  • Less time on admin. Accounts are set up once in the Resideo One portal, and emergency contacts, passcodes, zones, and site address are passed directly to Rapid Response. No duplicate data entry, data entry requests, or phone calls.

  • Simpler account management. With no receiver in the middle, there are no separate central station numbers to track. Dealers work with one Rapid Response account number and can activate, deactivate, and update accounts right from the portal.

  • Fewer errors. Account details come straight from the Dealer's Resideo One portal account instead of being re-keyed from a contract, so information is more accurate when it matters most.

  • Full visibility. Complete alarm history can be viewed right in the Resideo One portal, giving Dealers a clear picture of each account without calling the Monitoring Center.

  • Faster installs and service. Accounts can be fully set up before the truck rolls. Technicians can place a system on test and run a walk test right from the Resideo Technician app, without switching apps or calling the Monitoring Center.

"Resideo's goal is to make the entire experience faster, more reliable, and easier for Dealers to operate, while giving them a foundation that can evolve as their business and the security market evolve," said Nick Dalsin, Global Vice President, System, Services, Software Applications & Tools at Resideo. "Together with our partners like Rapid Response, Resideo continues to build on the reliability dealers expect while making it easier for them to manage their businesses, serve their customers and capitalize on new opportunities for growth."

"Our Dealers count on us for reliability, unmatched customer service, and to make their day-to-day easier, and this integration does exactly that," said Jeffrey Atkins, President of Rapid Response Monitoring. "Being the first Monitoring Center integrated with Resideo One means our Dealers get the benefit right away. It's another example of how we invest in technology that helps our Dealer partners work smarter and continue to grow their businesses."

Built in-house, built for Dealers
The integration was a close collaboration between Rapid Response's own Software Engineering Team and Resideo. The Rapid Response team is 100% on staff and never outsourced, which is rare among Monitoring Centers. That in-house expertise is what allowed Rapid Response to become the first Monitoring Center connected to Resideo One and to bring the benefits to the Rapid Response Dealer Network from day one.

Availability
The Resideo One integration is available now to Rapid Response Dealers installing compatible First Alert security solutions. Dealers attending Resideo CONNECT 2026 can meet the Rapid Response team in Marco Island to learn more, and any Dealer can get started by contacting their Rapid Response Account Representative.

About Rapid Response Monitoring
Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Syracuse, N.Y., Rapid Response Monitoring is a leading third-party alarm monitoring provider serving security Dealers across North America and helping protect 4+ million customers. With two fully redundant Command and Data Centers, plus a dedicated Customer Care Center, 100% In-Facility UL-Monitoring, a fully on-staff Software Engineering Team, and nearly 35 years of experience, Rapid Response delivers the technology, redundancy, and people Dealers rely on every day. Learn more at rrms.com.

About Resideo
Resideo is a global building technologies company that is a leading developer and manufacturer of critical control and sensing solutions for residential markets. The company serves professional installers and integrators across diverse product categories, such as heating, ventilation and air conditioning controls, combustion, life safety, security and water. Its comfort and protection solutions can be found in more than 150 million residential and commercial spaces globally, with tens of millions of new devices sold annually. More information about Resideo and its trusted brands, including BRK, First Alert and Honeywell Home, is available at Resideo.com.

Updates Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Outlook

DUBLIN, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ross Stores, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROST) today reported financial results for the 13‑week quarter ended October 31, 2026.

Highlights:

  • Total sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 increased a robust 12% versus last year, with comparable store sales up a strong 8%, primarily driven by customer traffic.
  • Third quarter operating margin of 12.3% increased 70 basis points compared to last year, above the Company's plan of 11.7% to 12.0%.
  • Earnings per share for the third quarter of $1.91 exceeded our guidance of $1.75 to $1.83.  
  • During the quarter, opened 51 new stores, including 41 Ross and 10 dd's DISCOUNTS, completing 2026 store opening plan of 115 new locations.

Jim Conroy, Chief Executive Officer, commented, "We are extremely pleased with our third quarter sales and earnings growth, particularly given the more challenging comparisons we faced. Results exceeded our expectations as our marketing initiatives continue to attract more customers while our compelling combination of great brands at exceptional values and an enhanced store experience continued to resonate. As a result, customer traffic remained the primary driver of our comparable store sales growth. We are encouraged by the broad-based strength of our results and the continued positive response from customers to our brands, values, and shopping experience."

Third Quarter and First Nine Months Results

Sales for the third quarter increased 12% to $6.3 billion, up from $5.6 billion in 2025. Comparable store sales rose a strong 8% for the quarter on top of a 7% gain last year. Net income was $606 million versus $512 million last year, while earnings per share were $1.91 compared to $1.58 per share in the prior year period.

For the first nine months of fiscal 2026, sales grew 15% to $18.5 billion, up from $16.1 billion in 2025. Comparable store sales for the nine-month period were up 11%. Net income was $2.1 billion versus $1.5 billion last year, while earnings per share were $6.59 compared to $4.61 per share in the prior year period.

Results for the first nine months of 2026 include approximately $253 million of IEEPA tariff refunds recognized in the second quarter, which benefited earnings per share by approximately $0.60.

Update on Shareholder Payouts

During the 2026 third quarter, a total of 1.4 million shares of common stock were repurchased for an aggregate price of $319 million under the Company's two-year $2.55 billion authorization approved by its Board of Directors in March 2026. The Company remains on track to buy back a total of $1.275 billion in common stock during fiscal 2026.

In addition, the Company's Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.445 per common share, payable on December 31, 2026 to stockholders of record as of December 8, 2026.

Fiscal 2026 Guidance

Mr. Conroy commented, "Looking ahead to the holiday season, we are excited about the opportunities in front of us and confident in the plans we have in place for the remainder of the year. For the fourth quarter, we are maintaining our outlook for comparable store sales growth of 4% to 5%, on top of last year's strong 9% gain. Earnings per share are expected to be in the range of $2.16 to $2.25 or growth of 8% to 13%."

Mr. Conroy continued, "Based on our year-to-date results and our updated fourth quarter guidance, we are increasing our 2026 fiscal year earnings per share projections to be in the range of $8.75 to $8.84. As a reminder, our full year guidance includes an approximate $0.60 earnings per share benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds recognized in the second quarter."

Mr. Conroy concluded, "The market share gains we have achieved reinforce our confidence in the opportunities ahead, and we believe we are well positioned to continue strengthening our competitive position and driving sustainable, profitable growth over the long term."

The Company will host a conference call on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 4:15 p.m. Eastern time to provide additional details concerning its third quarter results and management's outlook for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026. A real-time audio webcast of the conference call will be available in the Investors section of the Company's website, located at www.rossstores.com. An audio playback will be available at 201-612-7415, PIN #13763498 until 8:00 p.m. Eastern time on November 27, 2026, as well as on the Company's website.

First Alert® CX6T Advanced AI Camera and Resideo One portal combine intelligent video monitoring, AI-powered insights and connected services for small businesses

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Resideo Technologies (NYSE: REZI), a leading global provider of solutions for home comfort, security and safety, today introduced new AI-powered security solutions at its annual CONNECT Customer Event. Powered by Resideo's Pro-IQ™ services, the First Alert® CX6T Advanced AI Turret Camera and Resideo One portal support Resideo's broader strategy to deliver differentiated solutions while creating new software and services opportunities for its professional partners.

"This is a defining evolution of Resideo's security offering as we're integrating advanced video cameras with intelligent video management and services into one seamless and reliable offering," said Pat Tessier, Vice President of Product Development at Resideo. "Resideo is applying AI across the security experience, from detecting activity at the edge and finding events with natural language to turning video intelligence into actionable alerts, creating a more powerful connected security experience for users and new opportunities for our professional dealers."

The new AI-powered capabilities expand Resideo's connected security offering beyond standalone devices into an integrated portfolio of solutions, software and services designed to make enterprise-grade intelligence accessible to small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs).

Advanced Solutions for Growing Businesses
The CX6T camera and Resideo One portal combine AI video intelligence, live 4K video, intelligent event detection, natural-language video search and multi-site security management to help businesses monitor their properties and respond to security events quickly.

"Small businesses deserve access to the same intelligent video capabilities as larger enterprises, without the enterprise-level complexity or cost," said Tessier. "Resideo is combining advanced camera technology with our hybrid edge-and-cloud-based AI to deliver powerful, actionable insights at a price point designed for small businesses or larger homes."

For SMBs operating across multiple storefronts, offices or commercial properties, the CX6T camera and Resideo One portal together provide unified camera visibility across locations and help businesses:

  • See clearly, day or night. The CX6T delivers clear, detailed recordings even in challenging lighting conditions with 8MP ultra-high-resolution recorded video, live 4K video and superior low-light image quality and color retention, while high dynamic range (HDR) and AI-enhanced image processing help reduce grain, glare and motion blur.
  • Know when activity needs attention. Edge-based AI analytics help identify relevant security events while filtering out unnecessary alerts, with critical sound detection for smoke alarms, car alarms, breaking glass and screams.
  • Find and review important moments quickly. AI-powered semantic search enables users to locate video events in the app or portal using natural language, while hybrid storage combines continuous on-camera recording with cloud-based event clips for easy review, verification and sharing of important recordings.
  • Respond remotely and deter unwanted activity. A built-in microphone and speaker enable two-way audio through the Resideo Connect app and the Resideo One portal, while multi-color deterrence lights and a security siren help users respond to suspicious activity.
  • Add visibility where it's needed. A wide-angle lens expands coverage and camera-placement flexibility. For retrofits and upgrades, the CX6T is ONVIF-compliant* and supports integration with compatible existing video management systems.

The Resideo One portal brings these capabilities together through a centralized web experience giving security professionals and small businesses a single place to view and manage systems across multiple locations, review events and turn system information into actionable intelligence. With Pro-IQ Secure and Pro-IQ Protect services, security customers can benefit from ongoing intrusion and video services, intelligent analytics and cloud storage, creating new opportunities as customer needs evolve.

Availability
Together, the CX6T, Resideo One and Pro-IQ services reflect Resideo's strategy to combine connected devices with software, AI and services to create differentiated experiences for customers and new opportunities for its professional partners. In the coming months, the First Alert CX6T Advanced AI Camera will be available through security distributors in the U.S. and Canada, and portal features and Pro-IQ services will be introduced. Advanced video features and connected services may require a service subscription.

About Resideo

- Completion of patient enrollment in the multicenter IMPACT pancreatic cancer pilot study, with 48 patients enrolled across 10 clinical centers in the U.S., Canada and Israel following strong demand and three trial expansions -

- Dual listing on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE), followed by inclusion in the flagship TA-90 and TA-125 indices -

- Meaningful additional data anticipated from multiple trials in the coming months -

- Ongoing manufacturing scale-up, with the first stage of the Company’s Hudson, New Hampshire plant targeted to be ready for clinical trial supply by the end of 2026 -

- Cash, cash equivalents, short-term deposits and restricted deposits balance of $99.8 million provides runway for continued clinical advancement and commercial preparation -

JERUSALEM, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. (“Alpha Tau”, or the “Company”) (NASDAQ / TASE: DRTS, DRTSW), the developer of the innovative alpha-radiation cancer therapy Alpha DaRT®, reported third quarter 2026 financial results and provided a corporate update.

“Alpha Tau has tremendous momentum right now, and the new fantastic interim data from our REGAIN trial in recurrent glioblastoma showcase the true power of Alpha DaRT,” said Alpha Tau CEO Uzi Sofer. “While the trial started with a focus on feasibility and safety, we initially begin to see responses to the treatment, and are now seeing this translate into patient survival. We will continue to follow these patients closely as their scans mature, but we believe they speak to what a potent, highly localized alpha-emitting therapy may be able to do in even the hardest-to-treat tumors. With the FDA having approved the expansion of REGAIN to up to 20 patients, which we believe may support market submission requirements for Alpha DaRT, we are pressing ahead with enrollment, while preparing for mass production and commercialization if and when we are able to secure such an authorization.”

“The glioblastoma data reflect only one part of Alpha Tau’s much broader opportunity to meaningfully change how cancer is treated,” continued Mr. Sofer. “In recent months we completed enrollment of 48 patients in our multicenter IMPACT pancreatic cancer pilot study, after three expansions driven by strong demand, and treated the first immunocompromised patient in our ADMIRE study. We now expect meaningful additional data from multiple trials in the coming months, including top-line data from our pivotal ReSTART trial in recurrent cSCC, initial data from IMPACT, and additional interim data from REGAIN.”

“To be ready for the demand that we believe these data can generate, we continue to scale up our manufacturing capabilities. A central piece of that effort is bringing the first stage of our Hudson, New Hampshire plant online, which we are targeting to be ready for clinical trial supply by the end of 2026.”

“On the corporate front, we are very pleased to have come home to Israel with our dual listing on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, quickly followed by our inclusion in the flagship TA-90 and TA-125 indices. With a strong balance sheet of $99.8 million, a growing body of clinical evidence across multiple tumor types, and a dense calendar of data readouts ahead of us, we believe Alpha Tau has never been better positioned to translate this momentum into meaningful impact for patients.”

Recent Corporate Highlights:

  • In November 2026, Alpha Tau announced new interim results from its U.S. REGAIN (Recurrent Glioblastoma Alpha DaRT Intratumoral Therapy) trial of Alpha DaRT in recurrent glioblastoma (GBM), presented at the 31st Annual Meeting of the Society for Neuro-Oncology (SNO) in Philadelphia by the study investigator team from The Ohio State University Comprehensive Cancer Center. As of the November 11, 2026 data cut-off, all eight patients treated in the trial were alive and median overall survival had not been reached, with a median follow-up of 6.9 months from trial enrollment (range 3.1 to 11.6 months) in the six patients who had reached response assessment. All six of these patients (100%) achieved an objective response as their best overall response under RANO criteria, comprising five complete responses (83.3%) and one partial response (16.7%) with a 58% decrease in tumor measurements. On the trial’s primary endpoints of feasibility and safety, all planned Alpha DaRT sources were successfully deployed in all eight patients (100%), with no unanticipated serious adverse events. No definitive recurrence within the treated area has been reported in any patient, although one patient developed tumor progression away from the treated area approximately nine months after treatment. The results follow the FDA’s approval in October 2026 of an Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) supplement expanding REGAIN from 10 to up to 20 patients across three U.S. academic cancer centers and adding progression-free survival as a secondary endpoint, regular quality-of-life assessments and an additional interim analysis. The Company believes that the expanded trial could generate data that may support market submission requirements for Alpha DaRT in recurrent GBM. For more information, please see here: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06910306
  • In October 2026, Alpha Tau announced the inclusion of its ordinary shares in the flagship TA-90 and TA-125 indices of the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE), effective November 5, 2026, making Alpha Tau one of three biomed companies in the TA-125, with funds tracking these indices expected to add Alpha Tau shares to their holdings. The index inclusion follows the Company’s dual listing on the TASE in August 2026, which was undertaken in light of growing interest from Israeli investors and requests from the local investor base to trade the Company’s shares in local currency and during local business hours. The Company’s ordinary shares now trade on both Nasdaq and the TASE under the symbol DRTS.
  • In August 2026, Alpha Tau announced the completion of patient enrollment in its multicenter IMPACT (Intratumoral Pancreatic Alpha Combination Trial) pilot study of Alpha DaRT in pancreatic cancer, with 48 patients enrolled across 10 clinical centers in the United States, Canada and Israel. Originally approved for 12 patients, the study was expanded three times following strong demand, with the third expansion requested by participating clinical sites and broadening eligibility to multiple disease stages and both first-line chemotherapy regimens. IMPACT evaluates a one-time intratumoral Alpha DaRT treatment, delivered under real-time endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) guidance, as an add-on to first-line chemotherapy with either mFOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine with Abraxane® (nab-paclitaxel), in patients with newly diagnosed, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. For more information, please see here: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06698458
  • In July 2026, Alpha Tau reported positive results from a clinical study evaluating Alpha DaRT in combination with pembrolizumab (Keytruda®) in elderly patients with locally advanced and metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), delivered in a podium presentation at the American Head and Neck Society (AHNS) 12th International Conference on Head and Neck Cancer in Boston. Among all nine evaluable patients, the combination produced a systemic objective response rate of 100%, including four complete responses and five partial responses, compared to just 19% from historical benchmarks for pembrolizumab monotherapy in this setting. Median overall survival of 18.2 months and median progression-free survival of 5.4 months compared favorably with historical benchmarks for pembrolizumab monotherapy of 12.3 months and 3.2 months, respectively. No Alpha DaRT-associated serious adverse events were observed, and the study was stopped after the recruitment of 11 patients, having surpassed its pre-specified threshold for success.
  • In July 2026, Alpha Tau announced the successful treatment of the first patient in its ADMIRE (Alpha DaRT Management for Immunocompromised patients with recurrent cSCC) study, a clinical trial evaluating intratumoral Alpha DaRT in immunocompromised patients with recurrent cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), performed at Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center in Gilbert, Arizona. Immunosuppression is one of the strongest known risk factors for cSCC, and these patients are frequently excluded from clinical trials and often cannot safely receive checkpoint inhibitor immunotherapy. The prospective, multicenter, open-label, single-arm study is designed to enroll up to 28 patients at up to eight U.S. sites. For more information, please see here: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06615635

Expected Upcoming Milestone Targets:

  • First patient treated in U.S. locally recurrent prostate cancer pilot trial at year end 2026. For more information, please see here: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07290998
  • Top-line data in the ReSTART pivotal U.S. multi-center trial in recurrent cSCC in Q1 2027, followed by a potential submission to the FDA. For more information, please see here: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05323253
  • Additional interim data from the REGAIN recurrent GBM trial in the U.S. in Q1 2027. For more information, please see here: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06910306
  • Initial data from the IMPACT pancreatic cancer pilot study in H1 2027. For more information, please see here: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06698458

Financial Results for the Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
Research and Development expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $31.7 million, compared to $22.5 million for the same period in 2025, primarily due to increased employee compensation and benefits, including share-based compensation, increased clinical trial activity and payments to subcontractors, and increased raw material purchases.

Marketing expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $0.9 million, compared to $1.4 million for the same period in 2025, primarily due to decreased employee compensation and benefits.

General and Administrative expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $7.6 million, compared to $5.8 million for the same period in 2025, primarily due to increased employee compensation and benefits, including share-based compensation, and higher professional fees.

Financial expenses, net, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $58.5 million, compared to $0.6 million for the same period in 2025, primarily due to the remeasurement of warrants liability, as the public trading prices of the Company’s ordinary shares and publicly traded warrants rose over the period.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company had a net loss of $98.9 million, or $1.09 per share, compared to a net loss of $30.5 million, or $0.39 per share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

Balance Sheet Highlights

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents, short-term deposits and restricted deposits of $99.8 million, compared to $76.9 million at December 31, 2025.

About Alpha DaRT

Alpha DaRT® (Diffusing Alpha-emitters Radiation Therapy) is designed to enable highly potent and conformal alpha-irradiation of solid tumors by intratumoral delivery of radium-224 impregnated sources. When the radium decays, its short-lived daughters are released from the sources and disperse while emitting high-energy alpha particles with the goal of destroying the tumor. Since the alpha-emitting atoms diffuse only a short distance, Alpha DaRT aims to mainly affect the tumor, and to spare the healthy tissue around it.

About Alpha Tau Medical Ltd.

Founded in 2016, Alpha Tau is an Israeli oncology therapeutics company that focuses on research, development, and potential commercialization of the Alpha DaRT for the treatment of solid tumors. The technology was initially developed by Prof. Itzhak Kelson and Prof. Yona Keisari from Tel Aviv University.

Fuel Her Power provides practical nutrition guidance, drawing on more than 20 years of Herbalife's experience working alongside female athletes

LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Herbalife today announced the launch of “Fuel Her Power,” a nutrition guide for active women designed to help better understand their unique nutrition needs and how to support energy, performance, recovery and overall wellness. The guide is part of Herbalife's Fuel Her initiative, which builds on more than 20 years of experience working alongside female athletes to make sports nutrition knowledge more accessible to women and girls at every level of sport and activity.

Fuel Her Power Nutrition Guide by Herbalife

Women's participation in sports continues to grow, yet nearly half of all female athletes aren't getting enough energy to fuel their performance1. With only 6% of athletic performance studies focused exclusively on women2, significant gaps remain in understanding women's unique fueling, recovery and performance needs. As a result, many women are left navigating nutrition decisions without guidance that reflects their physiology, life stages and athletic goals, with consequences that can impact energy, recovery, and long-term wellness.

“Fuel Her Power” translates sports nutrition science into practical guidance covering fueling, hydration, recovery, hormone health and women's evolving nutritional needs. It is designed to make insights gained through elite sport relevant to active females everywhere, whether they compete professionally, participate in recreational sports, train for personal goals or simply want to stay active and feel their best. The guide was officially introduced Nov. 12 during a Fuel Her event hosted by Herbalife and Break Sports in Los Angeles. The event brought together female athletes, nutrition experts and community members to celebrate the guide's release and advance the conversation around women's sports nutrition.

As part of the “Fuel Her Power” guide launch event, Herbalife also recognized four accomplished female athletes whose careers reflect the dedication, resilience and adaptability required to compete at the highest levels of sport. The athletes recognized included:

  • Heather Jackson: An ultra-trail runner, gravel cyclist and former elite triathlete, Jackson has six IRONMAN victories, 16 Half IRONMAN wins and four top-five finishes at the IRONMAN World Championship. She most recently won the Javelina Jundred 100-mile race and has been a Herbalife-sponsored athlete for nearly 15 years.
  • Flavia Castro: An accomplished triathlete, Castro made history as the first woman from Bolivia to win gold at the World Triathlon Development Regional Cup and the first to reach the overall podium at an IRONMAN 70.3 event. She studies biochemistry and pharmacy and has been a Herbalife-sponsored athlete for three years.
  • Arianna Fontana: The most decorated Italian Olympian in history and the most successful short track speed skater of all time, Fontana has won 14 Olympic medals, including three golds, across six consecutive Winter Olympic Games. She has been a Herbalife-sponsored athlete for nearly a decade.
  • Emma Harvey: An Olympian and one of Bermuda's top female swimmers, Harvey represented her country at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games in the 100-meter backstroke. A national record-holder across multiple swimming disciplines, she has also represented Bermuda at the Commonwealth Games and World Championships.

Herbalife supports more than 120 professional athletes, teams and sports organizations across more than 35 sports, including partnerships with elite female athletes across multiple disciplines.

To learn more about Fuel Her and access educational resources, visit FuelHer.com.

Its live theatres are owned and operated by its Liberty Theaters subsidiary, under the Orpheum and Minetta Lane names. Its signature property developments, including Newmarket Village in Brisbane, Australia, and 44 Union Square in New York City, are maintained in special purpose entities.
